# artifactkeeper_repository_signing_config (Resource)

Per-repository signing configuration, which key signs, and whether metadata/packages are signed or signatures required. A singleton keyed by repository ID: no create/delete (the config is reset when the repository is removed), and writes upsert. Admin-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Sign this repository's metadata and packages with a repository-scoped key,
# and require artifacts to carry a valid signature.
resource "artifactkeeper_signing_key" "docker_local" {
  repository_id = artifactkeeper_repository.docker_local.id
  name          = "docker-local signing key"
}

resource "artifactkeeper_repository_signing_config" "docker_local" {
  repository_id      = artifactkeeper_repository.docker_local.id
  signing_key_id     = artifactkeeper_signing_key.docker_local.id
  sign_metadata      = true
  sign_packages      = true
  require_signatures = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository_id` (String) UUID of the repository whose signing config is managed. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `require_signatures` (Boolean) Whether artifacts must carry a valid signature (e.g. to pass the promotion gate). Defaults to `false`.
- `sign_metadata` (Boolean) Whether repository metadata is signed. Defaults to `false`.
- `sign_packages` (Boolean) Whether packages/artifacts are signed. Defaults to `false`.
- `signing_key_id` (String) UUID of the `artifactkeeper_signing_key` used to sign this repository's artifacts/metadata. Defaults to none (unconfigured). Note: the backend upsert merges over the existing config, so omitting this keeps the previously configured key rather than clearing it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier. Equal to `repository_id`, since the config is a singleton per repository.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The repository signing config is a singleton addressed by its repository ID.
terraform import artifactkeeper_repository_signing_config.docker_local <repository-uuid>
```
